newsitem.title: FRANCE: France,GAN in talks on aid plan-GAN source.
newsitem.headline: France,GAN in talks on aid plan-GAN source.

text.p: The French government and officials at state-owned Groupe des Assurances Nationales (GAN) are discussing an aid package for the insurance company but no decision has been taken, a company source said on Monday.
Earlier the French finance ministry said it had no comment on a report in daily Le Monde that GAN may need up to 20 billion francs to prepare for privatisation.
The afternoon daily also said the ministry and GAN were considering a privatisation scenario involving selling 30 percent of GAN by trade sale and the rest by public share offer.
It said the scenario would involve selling off the property business and the CIC bank unit as well as the two-pronged sale of GAN itself.
The source at GAN said a board meeting that had been scheduled for Tuesday has been postponed to mid-February and added that that decision was taken last week.
